<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed attacks and conflicts
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] releases video footage of two alleged Russian soldiers it captured. However, [[Russia]] denies the claims. [http://www.newsweek.com/isis-release-video-captured-russia-soldiers-moscow-denies-losing-syria-677106 (''Newsweek'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Hydraulic fracturing in the United Kingdom]]
**The [[Scottish Government]] [[Minister for Business, Innovation and Energy|Energy Minister]] [[Paul Wheelhouse]] announces that he will seek an indefinite [[Ban (law)|ban]] (an existing [[Moratorium (law)|moratorium]] has been in place since 2015) on [[Petroleum|crude oil]] recovery in [[Scotland]] by means of the process of [[hydraulic fracturing]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-41484153 (BBC)]
*[[Yahoo! data breaches]]
**[[Yahoo!]] reports that all three billion of its accounts were hacked in the [[Yahoo! data breaches#August 2013 breach|August 2013 data theft]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yahoo-cyber/yahoo-says-all-three-billion-accounts-hacked-in-2013-data-theft-idUSKCN1C82O1 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Hurricane Maria death toll controversy]]
**[[Governor of Puerto Rico|Puerto Rico Governor]] [[Ricardo Rosselló]]'s office reports that the number of deaths related to [[Hurricane Maria]] has risen to 34. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-puertorico-casualties/death-toll-in-puerto-rico-from-hurricane-maria-more-than-doubles-to-34-idUSKCN1C900B (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[United States District Court for the District of Columbia|U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia]] Judge [[Ellen Segal Huvelle|Ellen S. Huvelle]] awards [[Amir Mirza Hekmati]], a [[United States Marine Corps|U.S. Marine]] who was imprisoned in [[Iran]] as a [[False accusation|falsely accused]] [[Central Intelligence Agency|CIA]] [[Espionage|spy]], a [[default judgment]] of [[United States dollar|$]]63 million for his ordeal. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/us-judge-orders-iran-to-pay-63-million-to-ex-marine-tortured-imprisoned-four-years/2017/09/29/26aa9a0a-a54c-11e7-8cfe-d5b912fabc99_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Cuba–United States relations]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]], through the [[United States Department of State|Department of State]] and [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Rex Tillerson]], expels 15 [[Cuba]]n diplomats, after pulling half of its own embassy staff from [[Havana]] on Sept. 29, due to the alleged failure of Cuba to take appropriate steps to protect [[United States|American]] personnel against the [[Embassy of the United States, Havana#Alleged health attacks|mysterious health attacks]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cuba-diplomacy/u-s-expels-15-cuban-diplomats-drawing-protest-from-havana-idUSKCN1C81UE (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2017 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**[[Catalan general strike]]
***[[Catalan independence|Pro-independent]] trade unions, businesses, and schools in [[Catalonia]] hold a [[general strike]] to protest [[Spain|Spanish]] [[police brutality]] during the [[Catalan independence referendum, 2017|October 1 independence referendum]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2017/10/03/catalonia-goes-on-strike-as-calls-for-declaration-of-independence-grow.html (CNBC)]
***King [[Felipe VI]] addresses a message to the Nation in an exceptional speech, since it has only happened five times in 40 years of democracy amid the escalation of tension Catalonia is suffering. Noting the seriousness of the situation, condemns the irresponsibility of the [[Generalitat of Catalonia]] in wanting to break the unity of the country, the society and the legality. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/03/king-felipe-catalan-authorities-have-scorned-all-spaniards-with-referendum (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/spains-king-condemns-catalan-leaders-as-thousands-take-to-streets-idUSKCN1C80UK (Reuters)]
*[[Politics of Portugal]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Portugal]] [[Pedro Passos Coelho]] steps down as the leader of the opposition [[Social Democratic Party (Portugal)|Social Democratic Party]] in local elections. [http://www.politico.eu/article/portugals-opposition-leader-pedro-passos-coelho-steps-down-after-election-defeat/ (Politico)]
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**The [[U.S. House of Representatives]] passes legislation (Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act) which would criminalize abortions made 20 weeks into a pregnancy, except for cases endangering the mother's life, rape, or incest. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/03/politics/house-vote-abortion-after-20-week-ban/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Politics of Iraq]]
**Former [[President of Iraq]], [[Jalal Talabani]], dies at the age of 83. He was the first non-Arab president of Iraq. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-kurds-talabani/kurdish-leader-and-ex-iraqi-president-jalal-talabani-dies-state-tv-idUSKCN1C81J6 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41486847 (BBC)] 

;Science and technology
*[[Nobel Prize in Physics]]
**The [[Nobel Prize]] committee awards [[United States|Americans]] [[Rainer Weiss]], [[Barry Barish]], and [[Kip Thorne]] the [[List of Nobel laureates in Physics|Nobel Prize in Physics]] for their work in the [[LIGO Scientific Collaboration]] that [[First observation of gravitational waves|discovered]] [[gravitational waves]]. [https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/2017/press-release/ (Nobel Prize.org)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/speaking-of-science/wp/2017/10/03/nobel-prize-in-physics-won-by-rainer-weiss-barry-barish-and-kip-thorne/ (''The Washington Post'')]
